title: Mirror Lantern
central_conflict: their lantern was too faint to signal the hikers across the valley
decisive_choice: an old metal mirror could redirect the beam toward a clear gap
resolution: set the mirror at an angle and guided the hikers along the marked trail
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered their lantern was too faint to signal the hikers across the valley before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they lifted it higher, but the light vanished into the thick fog; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized an old metal mirror could redirect the beam toward a clear gap; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they set the mirror at an angle and guided the hikers along the marked trail, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Folded Letter
central_conflict: a folded letter was found inside a book with half its address missing
decisive_choice: the paper's watermark named the town's original post office
resolution: asked the postmaster to trace the missing address and returned the letter
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a folded letter was found inside a book with half its address missing before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.

title: Bell-Shaped Ball
central_conflict: a hollow ball stopped making its cheerful ringing sound
decisive_choice: a loose seam revealed a small metal bead trapped in the lining
resolution: opened the seam carefully and restored the ringing bead before the games
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a hollow ball stopped making its cheerful ringing sound before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they shook it harder, but the rattle inside stayed completely still; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a loose seam revealed a small metal bead trapped in the lining; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they opened the seam carefully and restored the ringing bead before the games, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
